newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE MONEY MARKET LIQUID, RATES MIXED.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE MONEY MARKET LIQUID, RATES MIXED.

text.p: Short term trading rates on Zimbabwe's money market were quoted mixed in quiet trade on Monday, dealers said.
The market opened in surplus and looks fairly comfortable at the moment," a dealer said.
Discount houses were buying treasury bills from the central Reserve Bank at the 19.36 percent set at Thursday's weekly tender but were selling them firmer at 19.20 percent from 19 percent.
NCD bills with maturity of 30, 60 and 90 days were being bought at 20.50 percent down from 21 percent while their selling rate edged up to 20 percent.
Bankers acceptances were buying at 20.25 percent and selling in a 19.85 to 20 percentage range from 20 and 19.25 percent while call money added one percentage point to 19 percent.
Figures from the Reserve Bank indicated an opening market surplus of Z$54 million.
